QuestInfo.name: Bone-chilling
QuestInfo.0: Corba, Leafre's sage, was so old that no one dared to guess his age. But something was troubling him lately...
QuestInfo.1: Corba says his body is not what it used to be and needs some warm clothes before it gets cold. He needs  #r#t4000913##k and #r#t4000914##k to make the clothing. But he is concerned about how people might view this so he is asking that you get the materials for him.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered the Harp's feather to make warm clothes for Corba the wiseman who is suffering from the cold.

0.0: Oh goodness, my bones, they are aching! That means winter is on its way. I'd best bundle up! \r\n
0.1: I-If you're not too busy, do you want to help an old timer out?

yes.0: So! Feathers are warm. Deliciously cozy. #r5 #t4000913##k and #r5 #t4000914##k items would help me stop shivering.
yes.1: But! I am supposed to be a wise man, not a cold man. What would the others think of me if they knew? You won't tell anyone, right?

no.0: I've heard this winter will be the most brutal on record, but you don't need to worry about me freezing or anything...

1.0: Did you bring me all the Harp Feathers?

yes.0: Mmm... so soft, yet so lightweight! Perfect for making clothes!

item.0: There are many Harps in #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k. Remember! #rFive #t4000913##k and #r5 #t4000914##k items.
